label: help
js: Kit.help.open(); new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => { const u = Kit.lang.untranslated(); Kit.help.close(); r(JSON.stringify(u)); }, 300))

label: toys, pair, bonk, wave
js: (() => { game.quiet(); const w = game.world(); w.cfg = Object.assign({}, w.cfg, {cat: 0}); const ts = w.toys.filter((t) => t.kind === 'bear'); game.put(0, ts[0].f, ts[0].x); game.step(0.05); game.put(0, ts[1].f, ts[1].x); game.step(0.05); const u0 = Kit.lang.untranslated(); const d = w.doors.find((q) => q.f === 1 && q.s === 1); d.open = false; game.put(0, 1, d.x - 0.9); w.players[0].inv = 9; game.cat(1, d.x + 0.9, {mood:'chase', moodT: 1e9}); dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{code:'Space'})); game.step(0.05); dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup',{code:'Space'})); game.step(0.2); const u1 = Kit.lang.untranslated(); const g = w.doors.find((q) => q.glow); g.open = false; game.put(0, g.f, g.x + 0.9); game.cat(g.f, g.x - 2.6, {mood:'chase', moodT: 1e9}); dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{code:'Space'})); game.step(0.05); dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup',{code:'Space'})); game.step(0.4); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify([u0, u1, Kit.lang.untranslated()])), 100)); })()

label: buddy
js: game.call(); game.step(0.7); const u = Kit.lang.untranslated(); game.step(1.2); game.call(); new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify([u, Kit.lang.untranslated()])), 200))

label: bounces, last bounce, tear
js: (() => { game.step(3); game.quiet(); game.putShaft(0, 1, 0, -1); for (let i = 0; i < 200 && game.state().p.mode === 'shaft'; i++) game.step(0.1); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify([game.state().p.mode, Kit.lang.untranslated()])), 100)); })()

label: hug
js: (() => { game.step(2.5); game.quiet(); game.put(0, 0, -1.5); game.world().players[0].inv = 0; game.cat(0, -1.0, {mood:'chase', moodT: 1e9}); game.step(0.3); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify([game.state().p.mode, Kit.lang.untranslated()])), 100)); })()

label: clear
js: game.resume(); game.quiet(); game.world().toys.forEach((t) => (t.got = true)); game.step(0.3); new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify(Kit.lang.untranslated())), 200))

label: next mansion
js: game.step(3.2); new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify([game.state().li, Kit.lang.untranslated()])), 200))

label: extra life
js: (() => { const p = game.world().players[0]; p.score = 19900; p.extra = false; game.world().phase = 'play'; const t = game.world().toys.find((q) => !q.got); game.put(0, t.f, t.x); game.step(0.05); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify(Kit.lang.untranslated())), 100)); })()

label: 2P hi5
js: (() => { game.start({ players: 2, go: true }); game.quiet(); game.call(); game.step(0.2); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify(Kit.lang.untranslated())), 100)); })()

label: 2P out, over
js: (() => { const w = game.world(); w.players[1].lives = 1; w.players[1].mode = 'hug'; w.players[1].t = 9; game.step(0.1); const u = Kit.lang.untranslated(); w.players[0].lives = 1; w.players[0].mode = 'hug'; w.players[0].t = 9; game.step(0.3); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify([u, Kit.lang.untranslated()])), 100)); })()

label: 2P results
js: game.step(2.5); new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify([game.state().screen, Kit.lang.untranslated()])), 300))

label: 1P results
js: (() => { game.start({ players: 1, go: true }); const w = game.world(); w.players[0].score = 4321; w.players[0].lives = 1; w.players[0].mode = 'hug'; w.players[0].t = 9; game.step(2.8); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify([game.state().screen, Kit.lang.untranslated()])), 300)); })()

label: english has no CJK (visible text, title, ? panel, play)
js: (() => { Kit.lang.set('en'); const scan = () => { const bad = []; const walk = (n) => { if (n.nodeType === 3) { const el = n.parentElement; if (/[\u3400-\u9fff]/.test(n.textContent) && el && el.getClientRects().length && getComputedStyle(el).visibility !== 'hidden') bad.push(n.textContent.trim().slice(0, 24)); return; } if (n.nodeType === 1 && (n.tagName === 'SCRIPT' || n.tagName === 'STYLE')) return; for (const c of n.childNodes) walk(c); }; walk(document.body); return bad; }; game.showTitle(); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => { const a = scan(); Kit.help.open(); setTimeout(() => { const b = scan(); Kit.help.close(); game.start({}); game.step(2); r(JSON.stringify({ title: a, help: b, play: scan() })); }, 300); }, 300)); })()
